review.description: S4/S5 hosted correctness qualification now prepares fixture inputs and delegates the shared strict qualifier instead of a shell sample loop. Other reconciliation/adoption scenarios and stable IDs are preserved. The trigger set now also includes the direct Make preparation executor scripts/verification_timing.py so executor-only edits request qualification.
review.implementation: Inspected both workflow snapshots: broadened browser/fixture/build/qualifier triggers, root working directory, prepared ui/plugin/fake-provider/browser inputs, direct qualifier output path, read-only permission, pinned checkout without persisted credentials and seven-day always-upload remain coherent. Against c347d49, the native Make timing graph, shared argument parser and explicit descriptor passing are retained byte-identically; only the hosted benchmark method changes inside test_ci.py. Confirmed Makefile npm-deps/ui/plugin-embed/fake-provider/browser-deps recipes directly execute verification_timing.py; its exact path is now a pull_request trigger without modifying executor or qualifier code. The timing executor unconditionally imports argument_parser and initializes specs_lib; exact arguments.py and __init__.py paths are therefore also triggers. Preparation command mode uses subprocess.run, so process-runner-only imports do not broaden the selected input set. Rebased only hosted integration onto c347d49. Verified ci.py and complete test_specs_timing.py byte-identical to that target; preserved selected hosted journal handling, bootstrap phase adjustment before refresh and durable resolved comparison before version collection. test_ci.py retains target setUp journal isolation; catalog/rendered references retain both dispatcher assertions.
review.tests: Read both test_ci workflow tests: the current stub asserts exact --output path, retains summary/discovery diagnostics for success and exit 19, and verifies propagated status, artifact name/paths/retention, fixture mode, checkout ref, preparation/order and triggers. Unchanged qualifier tests independently retain strict metric, ancestry and cancellation assertions. Inspected inherited test_keep_going_preserves_shared_preparation_and_comparison_arguments, test_native_expanded_comparison_matches_the_worker_under_variable_overrides and test_native_pipe_and_fifo_jobservers_survive_the_timing_boundary: shared-once preparation, exact actual comparison and pipe/FIFO capability preservation remain asserted and unchanged. The same existing hosted method now asserts verification_timing.py membership in pull_request paths; its configured-command success/exit-19 and retained diagnostics assertions are preserved and the focused method passed. The existing trigger loop also asserts exact shared parser and package-initializer paths; no new helper or qualifier test was added. Read and ran both inherited dispatcher tests: bounded real worker cases cover push/PR/manual/pinned-root success and exit 23 with exact comparison/source identity, fixture0, finalization and authoritative status; injected KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit143 persist comparison and correct root phase inventory before versions, start no worker and finalize interrupted evidence. Focused inherited tests passed; the mandatory tooling suite will include both.
